brief.purpose: Test repository-only onboarding and reuse by a separately assigned agent making a different world.

brief.name: Tidepool Commons
brief.author: Tidepool Commons learning collective (fictional)
brief.audience: Curious newcomers learning how to observe, compare interpretations and keep an attributed field notebook.
brief.scope: An imaginary coastal learning world; no real measurements, organization, research outcomes or safety advice are asserted.
brief.retainedDemonstrations: Template educational subsystems may remain when clearly attributed; do not pass Aaron's personal accounts off as the fictional author's.

isolation.context: Fresh agent with no parent conversation; only the brief and prepared repository snapshot are supplied.
isolation.inputs: Use files within the supplied repository snapshot and the created world. No surrounding project, original personal checkout, secrets or network content is needed.
isolation.sourceBasis: Record the snapshot manifest and source hashes before edits.
isolation.noAssistance: Read the repository's instructions first. Report blockers before accepting implementation hints from the parent. Retain failed attempts and fixes in the record.

acceptance: Create through the documented CLI with --template expedition.
Author the different world in canonical source; do not edit dist or the seed.
Build and run the created template's supported suite with actual test execution.
Verify 6–8 primary place routes, new identity and content, consistent atlas and source notes.
Verify a valid checked source edit and stale/invalid refusal preserve accepted source.

Observe browser reading/navigation, atlas visit/reset, Encounter edit/reset, claim comparison, interactive programme demo, media controls and reader workshop; record failures and unavailable observations honestly.
Check copied mechanism hashes and the unchanged 20-million execution budget.
Return reproducible changed-source files, commands, results, screenshots and remaining defects.
brief.evidenceBoundary: A separately assigned same-model agent in this task is an onboarding/transfer test. It is not an independent human study, scientific validation or evidence that every possible programme/input is correct.
brief.reopening: A failed criterion reopens the earliest affected template, documentation or feature dependency. Fix it in the reusable repository and repeat the affected trial rather than concealing the failure.
